journey: Accessibility/i18n: stable machine-code error vocabulary is surface-agnostic

narrative.step: an unauthenticated call returns a STABLE machine code, not English prose (client renders it)
narrative.assertion: no PAT → 401 {code:"unauthorized"} — a stable code the client renders in the user's language/modality

narrative.step: an invalid input surfaces the stable "invalid" code — same locale-agnostic contract
narrative.assertion: unpinned image → 400 {code:"invalid"}, no lease (machine code, not prose)

narrative.step: a not-found surfaces the stable "not_found" code — the third member of the locale-neutral vocabulary
POSITIVE control — an authed valid read returns structured JSON, not an English page
narrative.assertion: authed GET /v1/usage → 200 structured JSON (machine-first surface — inherently i18n/a11y-friendly); records residual
